nativeBaseline.reference: custom vertical listbox with native DOM focus on options

library: roving enabled-option focus with Up/Down, Home/End, and typeahead
consumer: provide a meaningful accessible listbox name
provide concise option names, stable values, application data, and form serialization/validation

notes: Server-rendered framework options remain ordinarily focusable before client activation; enhanced ports establish one roving Tab stop when composite behavior is active.
VyrnForge does not use selection-follows-focus for Listbox; Enter, Space, or pointer activation changes selection.
The current Listbox contract is vertical; a future horizontal orientation would require an explicit public contract and standards review.
